text.en: Most pet owners praise the veterinary team, noting that doctors like Dr. Wright and Dr. Merrill take time to examine animals thoroughly and explain treatment options. Reviewers appreciate that the team listens attentively during appointments. While one client felt compassion was lacking regarding care, the vast majority highlight a dedicated and supportive neighborhood clinic.

Clients frequently note how lovingly dogs and cats are treated during examinations and preventive visits. Several pet owners describe how veterinarians and assistants help soothe timid or anxious animals, making clinic visits calm and comfortable. Although one negative review expressed frustration with veterinary care, most owners feel completely confident leaving pets in their hands.

Pet owners consistently appreciate the clear and informative communication from veterinarians and support staff. Reviewers mention that clinical teams take time to answer all questions, explain preventive care for fleas and heartworms, and never rush consultations. Clients report feeling well informed and supported when making healthcare decisions for their household companions.

q.en: Does Lakewood Veterinary Center accept cats and dogs?

a.en: Yes, the clinic provides routine wellness examinations, preventive medicine, and medical care for both dogs and cats.

q.en: How do clients describe the consultation experience?

a.en: Reviewers highlight that veterinarians answer questions thoroughly, explain treatment options clearly, and avoid rushing appointments.

q.en: Is there an on-site pharmacy at the clinic?

a.en: Yes, the facility maintains an on-site pharmacy for prescription pet medications and preventive treatments.

q.en: Can pet owners schedule appointments in advance?

a.en: Yes, appointments can be scheduled by phone or requested through the clinic website.
